title: GitHub Actions windows-latest hosted runner
note: A workflow step on the standard x64 `windows-latest` runner (Windows Server 2025), public repository, running `npm install <pkg>` or `pip install <pkg>` with no secrets passed. The repository README at the pinned commit maps windows-latest to the windows-2025-vs2026 image; GitHub's runner page links the plain Windows 2025 image, which has the same Node 22.23 and Python 3.12.10 lines. POSIX root paths (/etc/...) do not exist on Windows; Windows paths, the user, home folder, locale, hostname and full environment are not documented, so those axes stay unknown.

readme.what: Windows Server 2025, image 20261007.264.1: Node 22.23.3, Python 3.12.10, NPM 10.9.9, pip 26.2.1, Yarn 1.22.22, tool list, CONDA and VCPKG_INSTALLATION_ROOT

hosted.what: public-repository hardware per label; Linux and macOS run with passwordless sudo, Windows as administrator with UAC disabled; Azure-hosted VMs that connect out to GitHub-owned endpoints
